about: Diner Dash 2: Restaurant Rescue is the second Diner Dash, published by PlayFirst in 2006, and the first sequel built inside PlayFirst rather than by gameLab, the studio behind the 2003 original. Flo is back behind the diners - this time rescuing four restaurants from the corporate clutches of the Mall-Mart style chain that keeps threatening her neighbourhood, one venue at a time.

The formula deepens rather than changes: seating, ordering, serving, bussing and chaining stay the verbs, while new customer archetypes join the originals - and the expert-scored shifts push the chaining maths harder than the first game ever did. Two players can share one PC, a series first carried by the PlayFirst-era builds.

PlayFirst folded into Glu Mobile in 2014 and the PC build left every store it ever shipped on, so the 2006 game sits in the un-buyable case: no official channel, no key server, preserved through archives and hosted originals only.
